g.text: Why the head never moves: `shift_right` is declared `fold`, and BOTH fold lanes reject it
The body is real, correct Rust and says exactly
what the paper's helper says: push `h` onto the
left context, take the first cell of `r` as the
new head, or `Sym::Blank` if `r` is empty.
so the extractor does not even prefer a moved tape
normal form: the write survives only as an unevaluated
THE TAPE NEVER CHANGES AND THE HEAD NEVER MOVES.
Nothing is silently wrong — no rule fires that should not,
and the report is honest. The helper simply has no
reduction rule anywhere in the generated system.
